caption: This shio ramen boasts a clear, golden broth, topped with chashu pork, a halved soft-boiled egg, nori, and menma, artfully arranged in a white bowl. Warm lighting highlights the dish against a dark wooden table.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with subtle grain patterns and a warm, reflective sheen under ambient light.
The chashu pork has a glistening, tender texture with a pinkish-brown hue and visible fat marbling, shaped in a thick, slightly curled slice.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, triangular, with visible veins and slightly curled edges.
The shio (salt) broth is golden-yellow, clear, and glossy, with thin noodles and green garnish visible beneath its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale, translucent, sliced pieces with visible fibrous texture and slight sheen.
A halved boiled egg shows a runny orange yolk surrounded by a firm white, with a slightly textured surface.
White ceramic bowl with glossy finish, featuring a black abstract mark and slightly uneven, smooth rim.
A white ceramic spoon with a small hole near its handle and a yellowish residue at its tip.
